description: Full-fidelity export of leads for offline analysis / backup. Returns { leads, count, limit, offset }. Each lead has ALL its columns, ai_memory[] (every AI-memory item attached to the lead — all categories, full untruncated content, newest first), and (unless disabled) nested contact and account objects. Same filters as list_leads. Paginate with limit (≤100) + offset — the whole base pulls in ceil(total/100) calls. Prefer this over list_leads when you need the complete data (list_leads trims memory for size).

custom.description: Filter on lead custom fields (list_custom_fields entity 'leads'): { key: value } — value = equals (multiselect: contains), array = any of (multiselect: contains all), null = empty. E.g. { "stufe": "A", "marken": ["KTM"] }.

min_score.description: Only export leads with at least this score (0-100)

no_campaign.description: Only leads not assigned to any campaign

stale_days.description: Only leads whose last activity is older than N days

name: export_leads
